data.$comment: The alarms.v1 profile's document (r3.2 §3.12). Generic: it carries no producer, host or source field, because the key names the publisher (system, service). Derived from ZenSight's Alert (zensight-common/src/alert.rs:100-147) with `source`, `protocol` and `kind` removed; ZenSight's `kind` rides `category`, which is NOT hashed into the key.

category.description: Free text naming what produced the alarm (ZenSight: anomaly | expectation | sensor_health). Not part of the key.

labels.description: Structured context. Every label that is not host-scoped is a discriminating label and enters the key recipe.

observed_at_ms.description: Present only on a content refresh of a still-firing alarm; always >= timestamp. Absent reads as 'not refreshed', never 'not observed'.

rule.description: Stable rule identifier. The first input of the key recipe.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch ms of the latest STATE TRANSITION (raised, escalated, resolved). It does not move while an alarm keeps firing or on a content refresh; an escalation moves it. Acknowledgements and timelines key off it (zensight-common/src/ack.rs, the historian's timeline uid).
